question: When is the GEMSSTAR R03 due?
expected: There are multiple cycles: new applications are due November 10, 2026, June 16, 2027 and June 16, 2028; resubmission applications (the only other type allowed) are due November 16, 2026, July 16, 2027 and July 16, 2028. All are due by 5:00 PM local time of the applicant organization.
quote: All applications are due by 5:00 PM local time of applicant organization.

question: What's the budget cap for this grant?
expected: Application budgets are limited to $125,000 in direct costs per year, and the project period is limited to 2 years.
quote: Award Budget Application budgets are limited to $125,000 in direct costs per year.

question: Is there an extra attachment I need besides the research plan, and how long can it be?
expected: Yes. Applicants must include an Other Attachment titled "Professional Development Plan" (PDP), and that section is limited to 5 pages.
quote: applicants are encouraged to describe specific activities that will augment their skills in geriatrics and/or aging research in order to develop into independent researchers in aging science. This section is limited to 5 pages.
